Lulu.escape: Your chance to close the distance comes after Lulu uses Lulu W Whimsy on another ally. Lulu has no dash to get herself out, so slow her with Zilean E Time Warp and attach Zilean Q Time Bomb.
Lulu.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Lulu's damage is mostly magic, and Zilean has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Lulu.combo: If Lulu lets you get within range and Lulu W Whimsy is down, slow her first with Zilean E Time Warp.
Lulu.fight: Lulu is strong at stopping a major engage, so keep poking with bombs and close the distance after Lulu W Whimsy is down. When Lulu uses Lulu E Help, Pix! on an ally, you get a chance to target Lulu herself. Before closing in, slow Lulu with Zilean E Time Warp to keep her in bomb range.
Lulu.laning: Stand behind minions to reduce the bonus damage from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion, and poke with bombs from behind or beside your allied ranged carry. Preemptively throw Zilean Q Time Bomb where Lulu will step to last-hit, but it costs a lot of mana, so use it only when she would have difficulty retreating. If the bomb attaches to a minion, it pushes the lane, so save it when you want to pull the lane toward you.
Lulu.phase: In the late game, Zilean's damage becomes a smaller share of the team's output, so protect allies with Zilean E Time Warp and Zilean R Chronoshift.
Lulu.teamfight: If Lulu R Wild Growth is available, don't focus on a target Lulu is protecting as though a kill is certain; look for Lulu herself or another target. If an enemy dives onto your backline, slow them with Zilean E Time Warp and stun them with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Cast Zilean R Chronoshift just before your team's main damage dealer is focused.
Lulu.watch: Lulu W Whimsy prevents you from using abilities and attacks, so don't force the distance while this ability is available. Also watch out for the slow from Lulu Q Glitterlance and the area knock-up from Lulu R Wild Growth. Don't go in expecting a guaranteed kill on a target Lulu R Wild Growth can still protect.

Milio.fight: After Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp and look for a bomb stun. Milio has no mobility ability, so this is a chance to close the distance, but fight from behind or beside your allied ranged carry rather than standing in front.
Milio.build: In the early game, withstand Milio's magic damage with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Choose your later resistances based on the enemy damage dealers' damage types. If the healing from Milio W Cozy Campfire and Milio R Breath of Life is enough to turn a fight, build Morellonomicon.
Milio.combo: If Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp, then use Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Attaching the second bomb makes the first detonate immediately and stun nearby enemies, so start when Milio would have difficulty leaving the bomb's radius.
Milio.escape: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is his only way to disengage, as it knocks back the first enemy hit, so the moment after Milio uses Q is your chance to close the distance. Then slow him with Zilean E Time Warp and attach Zilean Q Time Bomb to set up a stun.
Milio.laning: Throw Zilean Q Time Bomb where Milio will step to last-hit or walk, but consider its mana cost and the wave push if the bomb attaches to a minion.
Milio.teamfight: While Milio W Cozy Campfire increases the enemy ranged carry's attack range, delay the frontline fight. If an enemy dives onto your backline, slow the diving champion with Zilean E Time Warp and add a bomb stun. Cast Zilean R Chronoshift just before your team's main damage dealer is focused.
Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks back and slows the first enemy hit, so don't force the distance while this ability is available. If Milio W Cozy Campfire is active and increases the enemy ranged carry's attack range, delay the frontline fight and let its duration run out.

Brand.laning: Stand behind or beside your allied ranged carry and keep your distance so you don’t get hit by Brand’s area spells together. Preemptively throw Zilean Q Time Bomb where Brand will step to last-hit, but keep its mana cost and the chance of pushing the wave if it attaches to a minion in mind. Don’t stand next to burning minions.
Brand.build: Build Null-Magic Mantle first to survive the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Since Brand deals mostly magic damage and Zilean has relatively low magic resistance, build magic resistance first.
Brand.combo: After Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp, then use Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. If you place the second bomb on Brand while he already has one attached, the first detonates immediately and stuns him.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility spell, so the moment after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down is an opportunity to engage. If you’re ablaze, dodge the stun from Brand Q Sear first, then approach. If Brand remains within range, hold him with Zilean E Time Warp’s slow.
Brand.fight: Brand has no mobility spell, so slow him with Zilean E Time Warp and look for a bomb stun.
Brand.phase: In the late game, focus on protecting allies with Zilean E Time Warp and Zilean R Chronoshift rather than dealing damage yourself.
Brand.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Brand E Conflagration and Brand R Pyroclasm don’t spread, and don’t stand beside an ally who is ablaze. If Brand enters your backline, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp, then stun him with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Cast Zilean R Chronoshift just before your main damage dealer is focused.
Brand.watch: Dodge Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand Q Sear first to make it easier to prevent Blaze stacks. If you’re ablaze, move out of the projectile’s path or stand behind a minion to avoid the stun from Brand Q Sear. Watch for Brand E Conflagration to spread near burning minions, and spread out from allies when you see Brand R Pyroclasm being cast.

Alistar.phase: In the late game, focus on protecting allies with Zilean E Time Warp and Zilean R Chronoshift rather than dealing damage yourself.
Alistar.teamfight: If Alistar dives into your backline, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp and follow with a bomb stun to stop his engage. Cast Zilean R Chronoshift just before your main damage dealer is focused to save them. While Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, don’t waste time attacking him; back off or target the damage dealers behind him.
Alistar.watch: If Alistar W Headbutt closes the distance, Alistar can follow up with the knock-up from Alistar Q Pulverize and the stun from Alistar E Trample, so keep your distance. Near a turret, don’t let Alistar get behind you and create an opening to push Zilean under it.
Alistar.build: Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Since most of Alistar’s damage is magic and Zilean has relatively low magic resistance, build magic resistance first.
Alistar.combo: When Alistar walks toward you, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp, then stun him with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb.
Alistar.escape: Right after you bait out Alistar W Headbutt, his mobility spell is down and you have an opening to engage. If Alistar Q Pulverize is down too, close the gap during that window and counterattack with Zilean E Time Warp’s slow and a bomb stun.
Alistar.fight: Reposition and look for a trade right after Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize are down. If Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, back off instead of committing your damage, then fight again after it expires.
Alistar.laning: When Alistar steps forward and can’t easily retreat, throw Zilean Q Time Bomb, but keep in mind that attaching it to a minion will push the wave. Save your bomb when your allies are trying to pull the lane toward your side.

Morgana.build: In the early game, withstand Morgana's magic damage with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Zilean has no ability to escape after being caught, so magic resistance and tenacity are important. If the enemy's healing is enough to turn a fight, build Morellonomicon.
Morgana.combo: When Morgana E Black Shield is down, first apply a slow with Zilean E Time Warp, then use Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. If you attach the second bomb to the target carrying the first, the first detonates immediately and stuns nearby enemies.
Morgana.escape: The window to engage is when Morgana Q Dark Binding and Morgana E Black Shield are down. Morgana has no ability to create distance on her own, so slow her with Zilean E Time Warp and use the bomb combo. If linked by Morgana R Soul Shackles, speed yourself up with Zilean E Time Warp and escape before the stun detonates.
Morgana.fight: Keep a minion between you and Morgana to dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding, maintain your distance, and poke with Zilean Q Time Bomb. Don't waste a bomb stun on a target protected by Morgana E Black Shield; after the shield is down, slow them with Zilean E Time Warp to start a trade.
Morgana.laning: Throw Zilean Q Time Bomb where Morgana will walk when she steps up to last-hit, but save it when your allies want to pull the lane toward them so it doesn't attach to a minion and push the wave. Give the experience stored by Zilean P Time In A Bottle to an ally at the moment they reach an important level.
Morgana.phase: In the late game, protect allies with Zilean E Time Warp and Zilean R Chronoshift instead of stepping forward to deal damage.
Morgana.teamfight: Don't use a stun on a target protected by Morgana E Black Shield. If an enemy dives onto your backline, slow them with Zilean E Time Warp, then stun them with two bombs. When key attacks hit your team's main damage dealer, cast Zilean R Chronoshift just before they take lethal damage. Look for an area stun with bombs in a passage where enemies enter grouped together.
Morgana.watch: Morgana Q Dark Binding only catches the first target hit, so move with a minion between you and her. If linked by Morgana R Soul Shackles, speed yourself up with Zilean E Time Warp and get out of range before it stuns you.

Maokai.combo: After Maokai W Twisted Advance is down and his dash has ended, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp, then use Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. If you attach the second bomb to the target carrying the first, the first detonates immediately and stuns nearby enemies. To avoid unnecessarily triggering Maokai's healing, use the combo on the enemy damage dealer if you can hit them.
Maokai.build: In the early game, withstand the pressure with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against Maokai's damage, and get tenacity to reduce the duration of his root. If Maokai P Sap Magic heals enough to turn a fight, build Morellonomicon.
Maokai.escape: The moment after you make Maokai use Maokai W Twisted Advance is your chance to close the distance and go in. If Maokai R Nature's Grasp is ready or you're in a narrow passage, first make sure you have room to dodge the root. If you're at risk of being caught, speed yourself up with Zilean E Time Warp and use Zilean W Rewind to refresh E.
Maokai.fight: Keep your distance while Maokai W Twisted Advance is ready, and trade right after W is down. Slow him with Zilean E Time Warp, then look for a bomb stun. Repeatedly hitting Maokai with abilities makes his healing come back sooner, so focus your poke on the enemy damage dealer when possible.
Maokai.laning: Preemptively throw Zilean Q Time Bomb where Maokai will step to last-hit, but consider both your mana and the chance of pushing the wave. When Maokai W Twisted Advance is ready, don't enter range near brush.
Maokai.phase: In the late game, focus on protecting allies with Zilean E Time Warp and R rather than poking with bombs.
Maokai.teamfight: If Maokai dives onto your backline, wait until he lands, then slow him with Zilean E Time Warp and stun him with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Cast Zilean R Chronoshift just before your team's main damage dealer is focused to give them a chance to revive. Fight in open terrain where there's room to dodge Maokai R Nature's Grasp.
Maokai.watch: Maokai W Twisted Advance dashes in and roots, and he can't be targeted during the dash, so use abilities after he lands. Don't enter brush where Maokai E Sapling Toss is placed. If Maokai R Nature's Grasp comes from far away, dodge perpendicular to its direction of travel.

Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a wall or a second target, so keep your back away from walls and don’t stand in a line with an ally or minion. Bard E Magical Journey lets him flank, so don’t leave that approach open. Bard R Tempered Fate can make both allies and enemies immune to damage, so watch its area and the fight that may follow.
Bard.build: Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Bard deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Bard W Caretaker's Shrine is enough to turn a fight, build Morellonomicon.
Bard.combo: After Bard E Magical Journey is down, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp, then use Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Attaching the second bomb to the same target detonates the first one immediately and stuns nearby enemies. Don’t rush if Bard can move out of the bomb’s radius.
Bard.escape: The moment after Bard E Magical Journey is down is Zilean’s window to engage. If you’re positioned to avoid the stun angle of Bard Q Cosmic Binding, slow Bard with Zilean E Time Warp and land Zilean Q Time Bomb.
Bard.fight: After you bait out Bard E Magical Journey, you have an opportunity to close the gap. Position yourself to avoid the stun angle of Bard Q Cosmic Binding, then slow Bard with Zilean E Time Warp and look for a bomb stun. Fight from behind or beside your allied ranged carry rather than standing in front.
Bard.laning: Poke Bard with Zilean Q Time Bomb when he steps forward to last-hit or is in a position where he can’t easily retreat. If the bomb attaches to a minion, it will push the wave, so save it when pulling the lane and use it when pushing and moving around.
Bard.phase: In the late game, focus on protecting allies with Zilean E Time Warp and Zilean R Chronoshift rather than dealing damage.
Bard.teamfight: Watch the direction Bard E Magical Journey can come from. Against enemies who dive your backline, use Zilean E Time Warp and Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Cast Zilean R Chronoshift just before your main damage dealer is focused to give them time to counterattack. Look for bomb stuns in passages where enemies enter grouped together.

Braum.phase: In the late game, focus on protecting allies with slows and resurrection rather than dealing damage as Zilean.
Braum.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance against Braum’s main damage, but tenacity is also important for Zilean, who has no mobility spell, to deal with Braum’s stuns and knock-ups.
Braum.combo: After Braum W Stand Behind Me is down and Braum E Unbreakable’s shield is lowered, slow Braum with Zilean E Time Warp.
Braum.escape: The moment after Braum W Stand Behind Me is down is an opportunity to close the gap. If Braum E Unbreakable is down too, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp and land a bomb. Conversely, if Braum P Concussive Blows has marked you, don’t engage; move out of range before the stacks reach full.
Braum.fight: Don’t throw bombs directly into the front of Braum E Unbreakable while it is raised. Start trading when the shield is lowered or after Braum W Stand Behind Me is down. Slow Braum with Zilean E Time Warp and look for a bomb stun; don’t fight for long within his engage range.
Braum.laning: Stand behind or beside your allied ranged carry, with minions between you and Braum, to dodge Braum Q Winter's Bite. Poke with Zilean Q Time Bomb when Braum steps forward to last-hit or is in a position where he can’t easily retreat. If the bomb attaches to a minion, it will push the wave, so save it when you want to pull the lane.
Braum.teamfight: Avoid the straight-line path of Braum R Glacial Fissure and protect your main damage dealer from behind. If Braum gets onto an ally, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp and look for a stun with your bomb combo. Cast Zilean R Chronoshift after you see a major attack hit your main damage dealer.
Braum.watch: Braum Q Winter's Bite hits the first enemy it reaches, so stand behind minions. If it hits you, back away before the stacks of Braum P Concussive Blows trigger a stun. When you see the cast animation for Braum R Glacial Fissure, move sideways out of its path and avoid the slowing zone it leaves behind.

Senna.phase: In the late game, watch out for the increased range and attack damage from Senna P Absolution. As Zilean, focus on protecting allies rather than poking.
Senna.build: Senna’s main damage is physical, and Zilean has relatively low armor, so build armor first. In the early game, hold out with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If Senna Q Piercing Darkness heals enough to turn a fight, build Morellonomicon and apply Grievous Wounds with Zilean Q Time Bomb.
Senna.combo: When Senna steps forward to collect a soul, slow her first with Zilean E Time Warp. Start when she can’t get out of the bomb’s radius.
Senna.escape: After Senna W Last Embrace misses, close the distance and look for a chance to cast Zilean E Time Warp. If Senna has increased her movement speed with Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, pin her down with Zilean E Time Warp’s slow and follow up with a bomb stun.
Senna.fight: If Senna hits you once, retreat before allowing a second attack to prevent her from collecting mist.
Senna.laning: Anticipate where Senna will step out to collect a soul, and throw Zilean Q Time Bomb there to make her give it up. Stand behind minions to dodge Senna W Last Embrace, but stay out of the straight line where Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through minions. If the bomb attaches to a minion, it will push the lane, so save it when you want to pull the lane back and use it when you want to push and join your team.
Senna.teamfight: If you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, retreat to secure vision or throw Zilean Q Time Bomb into the mist to prevent an approach. If an enemy enters your backline, slow them with Zilean E Time Warp and stun them with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Cast Zilean R Chronoshift just before your main damage dealer is focused.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through allies or minions in a straight line, so avoid the line between Senna and her target. If Senna W Last Embrace hits you, move away from your allies before the root triggers so you aren’t rooted together. If you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, camouflaged enemies may approach, so retreat to an area with vision.

Ashe.build: Ashe deals mostly physical damage, and Zilean has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Buy Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Ashe.combo: Slow Ashe with Zilean E Time Warp, then use Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. If you place the second bomb on Ashe while the first is attached, the first detonates immediately and stuns nearby enemies.
Ashe.escape: Ashe has no skill that lets her create distance herself, so the moment after Ashe W Volley is down is an opportunity to approach. Don’t start a fight from out of vision while Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, and keep your distance while Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active.
Ashe.fight: Trade after Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has ended. Ashe has no way to create distance herself, so slow her with Zilean E Time Warp and look for a bomb stun.
Ashe.laning: Try placing Zilean Q Time Bomb when Ashe steps forward to last-hit, and keep in mind that if she backs away and the bomb attaches to a minion, it can push the wave. Zilean Q Time Bomb costs a lot of mana, so use it when Ashe is in a position where she can’t easily retreat.
Ashe.phase: In the late game, focus on protecting allies with Zilean E Time Warp and Zilean R Chronoshift rather than dealing damage yourself.
Ashe.teamfight: Protect your allies from behind. When Ashe attacks an ally, slow her with Zilean E Time Warp and look for a stun with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Cast Zilean R Chronoshift just before your main damage dealer is focused to save them. In a narrow passage, you can stun multiple enemies with a bomb if they enter grouped together.
Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley slows in an area, so dodge it by moving to the side of its cone and look to trade right after it is down. Ashe P Frost Shot refreshes its slow with every basic attack, so don’t stay within her basic attack range for long. Back away when Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, and don’t start a small fight from out of vision while Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available.

Blitzcrank.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first to build magic resistance early. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Magic resistance won’t mitigate the physical damage from Blitzcrank E Power Fist.
Blitzcrank.combo: Once Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is down and he is within range, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp.
Blitzcrank.escape: The moment after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses is an opportunity to engage and trade. Blitzcrank has no skill to create distance himself, so slow him with Zilean E Time Warp and land a bomb then. Keep your distance while his hook is available.
Blitzcrank.fight: Look to trade right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses or when he is low on mana. If he is within range, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp and look for a bomb stun. Zilean has no skill to escape on his own, so don’t stand in front and engage first.
Blitzcrank.laning: Stand behind minions rather than beside them to block the path of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. If Blitzcrank misses his hook, push the lane or poke him. When you want to pull the lane toward your side, save Zilean Q Time Bomb because attaching it to a minion can push the wave.
Blitzcrank.phase: In the late game, focus on protecting allies rather than poking.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: Stand behind your allies. The moment Blitzcrank gets on an ally, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp and follow with a bomb stun. Cast Zilean R Chronoshift just before your main damage dealer is focused. Blitzcrank can survive with his shield, so don’t chase him forward without a way to finish him off.
Blitzcrank.watch: If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab pulls you in, he can follow up with the knock-up from Blitzcrank E Power Fist and the silence from Blitzcrank R Static Field. Keep minions in front of you, and stay away from bushes when you don’t have vision inside them.

Heimerdinger.build: Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Heimerdinger’s main damage is magic, and Zilean has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Heimerdinger.combo: When you can reach Heimerdinger himself, slow him first with Zilean E Time Warp, then use Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. When the second bomb attaches, the first detonates immediately and stuns nearby enemies, so start when Heimerdinger can’t easily leave the bomb’s radius.
Heimerdinger.escape: Heimerdinger has no skill to create distance himself, so if you’ve worked around his turret setup and gotten close, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp. If you’re hit by his grenade, don’t continue the engage; get out of turret range.
Heimerdinger.fight: If you close the gap, slow Heimerdinger with Zilean E Time Warp and hold him with a bomb stun.
Heimerdinger.laning: Save mana by using Zilean Q Time Bomb when Heimerdinger steps forward to last-hit or is in a position where he can’t easily retreat. If the bomb attaches to a minion, it will push the wave, so use it less when you want to pull the lane.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: If Heimerdinger tries to reach your backline, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp, then stun him with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Watch for a major attack to hit your main damage dealer, then cast Zilean R Chronoshift before they take fatal damage.

Hwei.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Hwei's damage is mostly magic, and Zilean has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster deals damage based on your max health, so avoid relying on health alone.
Hwei.combo: After Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, slow Hwei with Zilean E Time Warp. Start from a distance where Hwei can't get out of the bomb's radius.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility ability, so the moment after Hwei E Subject: Torment is down is your window to engage. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, the lead engager could be rooted or knocked back, so check that ability before going in.
Hwei.fight: The moment after Hwei uses Hwei E Subject: Torment to poke or clear the wave is your chance to close the distance. Then slow Hwei with Zilean E Time Warp and look for a stun with two Zilean Q Time Bombs. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, don't force an engage first.
Hwei.laning: Throw Zilean Q Time Bomb where Hwei will step to last-hit, but keep in mind that attaching it to a minion will push the wave. If an ally is about to enter along a path covered by Hwei's eye, take another route or let minions trigger and expend it first.
Hwei.phase: In the late game, focus on protecting allies with Zilean E Time Warp and Zilean R Chronoshift rather than dealing damage as Zilean.
Hwei.teamfight: Watch whether Hwei E Subject: Torment is available, since it can stop an ally's lead engage. If an enemy dives onto your backline, slow them with Zilean E Time Warp and stun them with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Cast Zilean R Chronoshift just before your team's main damage dealer is focused.
Hwei.watch: If Hwei E Subject: Torment roots or displaces you, you are likely to take the follow-up damage too, so don't engage first while this ability is available. If one of Hwei's abilities hits you, move immediately to avoid the second ability and Hwei P Signature of the Visionary's explosion. If slowed by Hwei R Spiraling Despair, use Zilean E Time Warp to create distance.

Janna.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Janna deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Janna R Monsoon is enough to turn a fight, build Morellonomicon.
Janna.combo: When engaging Janna, slow her first with Zilean E Time Warp. If your target is protected by Janna E Eye Of The Storm, wait until the shield is gone or target someone else.
Janna.escape: The moment after Janna Q Howling Gale misses is a good window to engage. If Janna disappears from vision, she may have a tornado ready, so don’t enter from that direction. If Janna can use Janna R Monsoon in the fight, account for the possibility that you’ll need to re-engage after being knocked back.
Janna.fight: Poke the ally Janna is protecting to make her use Janna E Eye Of The Storm, then commit your damage once the shield is gone. If Janna is separated from her allies or Janna Q Howling Gale misses, slow her with Zilean E Time Warp and look for a bomb stun.
Janna.laning: Throw Zilean Q Time Bomb where the ally Janna is protecting will step forward, to consume Janna E Eye Of The Storm and make her waste Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr. If the bomb attaches to a minion, it will push the wave, so save Zilean Q Time Bomb when you want to pull the lane.
Janna.phase: In the late game, focus on protecting allies with Zilean E Time Warp and Zilean R Chronoshift rather than dealing damage yourself.
Janna.teamfight: If Janna is positioned behind an allied damage dealer, she can knock back an engage, so establish vision and look for a moment when she is isolated. When Janna uses Janna R Monsoon, look to interrupt it with a Zilean Q Time Bomb stun. Cast Zilean R Chronoshift just before your main damage dealer is focused, and if an enemy enters your backline, slow them with Zilean E Time Warp and follow with a bomb stun.
Janna.watch: Janna Q Howling Gale knocks you up, so if you hear a tornado from out of vision, move out of its path. Don’t focus your damage on a target protected by Janna E Eye Of The Storm. Janna R Monsoon knocks back nearby enemies and heals, so be ready to stun her with Zilean Q Time Bomb if she uses it during a fight.

Karma.build: In the early game, withstand Karma's magic damage with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If Karma's healing is enough to turn a fight, build Morellonomicon to apply Grievous Wounds with area bombs.
Karma.combo: If Karma W Focused Resolve is down, slow Karma with Zilean E Time Warp, then use Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. If you attach the second bomb to the target carrying the first, the first bomb detonates immediately and stuns nearby enemies.
Karma.escape: Your window to engage is after Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E is gone. Check whether the movement speed from Karma E Inspire is still active, then close the distance and use Zilean E Time Warp's slow to make it harder for her to escape the bomb's radius.
Karma.fight: Keep your distance while Karma W Focused Resolve is available so you aren't rooted first. After Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E is gone, slow her with Zilean E Time Warp and look for a bomb stun.
Karma.laning: Preemptively throw Zilean Q Time Bomb where Karma will step to last-hit, but keep in mind that attaching it to a minion will push the lane. Zilean Q Time Bomb costs a lot of mana, so use it when Karma would have difficulty retreating.
Karma.phase: In the mid game, push the lane and then join your allies. In the late game, focus on protecting allies rather than poking.
Karma.teamfight: Engage after the area shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E is gone. If Karma dives onto your backline, slow her with Zilean E Time Warp and stun her with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Cast Zilean R Chronoshift just before your team's main damage dealer is focused.
Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame is an area slow used to poke, so avoid it from behind minions or outside its range. If hit by the zone left by Karma R Mantra-empowered Q, move out of the circle before it detonates again.

Leona.build: In the early game, build Null-Magic Mantle first to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Leona's damage is mostly magic, and Zilean has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team has a lot of crowd control to lock down your team's main damage dealer, build Mikael's Blessing between core items.
Leona.combo: After Leona E Zenith Blade is down, slow her with Zilean E Time Warp, then use Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. If you attach the second bomb to the target carrying the first, the first detonates immediately and stuns nearby enemies. Start when Leona can't leave the bomb's radius during the three inputs.
Leona.escape: The moment after you make Leona use Leona E Zenith Blade is your window to go in. If Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and the crowd control from Leona R Solar Flare are also down, close the distance and counterattack with Zilean Q Time Bomb. Use Zilean E Time Warp to slow Leona or speed yourself up so you don't give her another chance to catch you.
Leona.fight: Close the distance and counterattack with Zilean Q Time Bomb right after Leona E Zenith Blade is down. When engaging, slow Leona with Zilean E Time Warp, then look for a bomb stun. Don't stand in front and start trading while Leona still has her engage ability available.
Leona.laning: Position so Leona and your allied ranged carry aren't lined up, and throw Zilean Q Time Bomb when Leona would have difficulty retreating. If the bomb attaches to a minion, it pushes the wave, so save it when you want to pull the lane toward you and use it when you have pushed and are joining your allies.
Leona.phase: In the late game, Zilean's damage becomes relatively low, so protect allies with Zilean E Time Warp and Zilean R Chronoshift.
Leona.teamfight: If Leona dives onto your backline, slow her with Zilean E Time Warp and add a stun with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Cast Zilean R Chronoshift just before your team's main damage dealer is focused. If a Leona P Sunlight mark is applied, that signals follow-up damage is coming, so don't move forward; retreat.
Leona.watch: Leona E Zenith Blade pierces in a straight line and pulls her to the last champion hit, so don't stand in a line with your allied ranged carry. Leona can approach with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak already primed, so don't give her enough range to reach you. When the marker for Leona R Solar Flare appears, move sideways to avoid the center stun; when Leona W Eclipse is active, get out of its area before it explodes.

Lux.build: In the early game, build Null-Magic Mantle first to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Lux's damage is mostly magic, and Zilean has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Lux.combo: After Lux Q Light Binding is down, slow Lux with Zilean E Time Warp, then use Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Attaching the second bomb makes the first detonate immediately and stun nearby enemies. Apply the slow first so Lux can't leave the bomb's radius between casts.
Lux.escape: Lux has no mobility ability, so when engaging, look for the moment after Lux Q Light Binding misses. If Zilean needs to retreat, speed yourself up with Zilean E Time Warp and use Zilean W Rewind to refresh Zilean E Time Warp.
Lux.fight: The moment after Lux Q Light Binding misses is your chance to trade and engage. If you've closed the distance, slow Lux with Zilean E Time Warp and look for a bomb stun. Zilean's damage is mostly magic and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so bomb damage is effective.
Lux.laning: Stand behind or beside your allied ranged carry, and spread out sideways from your allies so you aren't hit alongside them by Lux Q Light Binding. Throw Zilean Q Time Bomb where Lux will walk when she steps up to last-hit, but consider both its mana cost and the chance that a bomb attaches to a minion and pushes the lane. Save bombs when pulling the lane toward you; use them to push the wave when you're pushing and joining your allies.
Lux.phase: In the late game, focus on protecting allies with Zilean E Time Warp and Zilean R Chronoshift rather than dealing damage as Zilean.
Lux.teamfight: Approach spread out from your allies so Lux E Lucent Singularity can't catch you all together. When Lux targets an ally, slow her with Zilean E Time Warp and look for a stun with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Cast Zilean R Chronoshift just before your team's main damage dealer is focused.
Lux.watch: Lux Q Light Binding can pass through the ally in front and root two people, so don't stand in a line with your allies. If rooted, you're likely to get hit by Lux E Lucent Singularity and Lux R Final Spark too, so bait out and dodge Lux Q Light Binding before moving. When the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark appears, move sideways. If marked by Lux P Illumination, create distance so you don't get hit by the empowered basic attack.

Nami.build: Early, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance because most of Nami's damage is magic and Zilean has relatively low magic resistance. Build Morellonomicon if the healing from Nami W Ebb and Flow can turn a fight around.
Nami.combo: After Nami misses Nami Q Aqua Prison, close the gap and slow her with Zilean E Time Warp. Start when Nami cannot get out of the bomb's radius.
Nami.escape: The moment after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is your chance to engage. If you see Nami R Tidal Wave, sidestep first, watch for the follow-up Nami Q Aqua Prison, then close the gap. Nami has no mobility, so if you get close, you can catch her with Zilean E Time Warp's slow and a bomb stun.
Nami.fight: Try to trade on Nami right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses. Nami has low health and no mobility, so if you close the gap, slow her with Zilean E Time Warp and look for a bomb stun. Zilean has few ways to escape on his own, so dodge Nami's crowd control first and manage your distance.
Nami.laning: Stand behind or beside your allied marksman, and throw Zilean Q Time Bomb as soon as Nami steps forward. If the bomb attaches to a minion, it pushes the wave, so save it when you want to pull the lane. After pushing the wave, you can speed up an ally with Zilean E Time Warp and rotate together.
Nami.phase: In the late game, focus on protecting allies with Zilean E Time Warp and Zilean R Chronoshift rather than dealing damage.
Nami.teamfight: When an ally is caught by Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave and takes follow-up attacks, use Zilean R Chronoshift to protect an ally who is about to take lethal damage. If an enemy gets into your backline, slow them with Zilean E Time Warp and stun them with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. If enemies group in a narrow passage, look for an area-of-effect bomb stun.
Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison stuns you and can lead into follow-up attacks, so sidestep when you see its landing indicator. Sidestep as soon as you see Nami R Tidal Wave, then watch for the Nami Q Aqua Prison that follows. Keep your distance from enemies affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing, and fight again after its duration ends.

Nautilus.build: Early, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance because Nautilus's main damage is magic.
Nautilus.combo: After Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp and use Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. The second bomb immediately detonates the first, stunning Nautilus and nearby enemies.
Nautilus.escape: The moment after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses is your window to close the gap. After trading, use Zilean E Time Warp on yourself to create distance, and use Zilean W Rewind to get E back if needed.
Nautilus.fight: Trade right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses. Slow Nautilus with Zilean E Time Warp and attack with Zilean Q Time Bomb, but don't get close enough for Nautilus P Staggering Blow to reach you.
Nautilus.laning: Keep a minion between you and Nautilus to block Nautilus Q Dredge Line, and throw Zilean Q Time Bomb where Nautilus will step forward. If the bomb attaches to a minion, it pushes the wave, so save it when you want to keep the lane pulled back.
Nautilus.phase: In the late game, focus on protecting allies with Zilean E Time Warp and R rather than poking with bombs.
Nautilus.teamfight: If Nautilus gets into your backline, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp and stun him with two bombs. Use Zilean R Chronoshift just before your main damage dealer is focused. Don't stand in line with allies along the path of Nautilus R Depth Charge.
Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line both engages and stuns, so avoid it by keeping minions between you and him. Nautilus P Staggering Blow can lead into follow-up abilities if it roots you, so don't stay within his basic attack range. When Nautilus has R Depth Charge available, don't stand in line with allies along its path.

Neeko.build: Early, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance because Neeko's main damage is magic and Zilean has relatively low magic resistance. Prioritize tenacity if Neeko E Tangle-Barbs into Neeko R Pop Blossom can kill you.
Neeko.combo: When engaging Neeko, slow her with Zilean E Time Warp, then use Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. If you place the second bomb on the target carrying the first, the first detonates immediately and stuns nearby enemies. Start when Neeko is stopped or slowed and can't get out of the bomb's radius.
Neeko.escape: Look to engage just after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down or while Neeko R Pop Blossom is down. Don't follow the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter and change your engage direction.
Neeko.fight: Zilean has no escape ability, so if Neeko E Tangle-Barbs catches you, you're likely to be hit by what follows; keep your distance as you fight. Start a trade with Zilean Q Time Bomb when Neeko stops moving or is slowed by Zilean E Time Warp.
Neeko.laning: Throw Zilean Q Time Bomb where Neeko will walk when she steps up to last-hit, and account for its mana cost and the wave pushing if the bomb attaches to a minion. Poke from behind or beside your allied marksman, and spread out so Neeko E Tangle-Barbs doesn't catch you both.
Neeko.phase: In the late game, focus on protecting allies with Zilean E Time Warp and Zilean R Chronoshift rather than dealing damage.
Neeko.teamfight: If an enemy transformed with Neeko P Inherent Glamour gets close to an ally, suspect Neeko R Pop Blossom and spread out. When Neeko enters your backline, slow her with Zilean E Time Warp and stun her with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Use Zilean R Chronoshift just before your main damage dealer is focused.
Neeko.watch: If an enemy transformed with Neeko P Inherent Glamour approaches, suspect their identity and spread out in advance. Neeko E Tangle-Barbs can easily root allies standing behind the first target, so don't stand together. Move out of range when you see Neeko R Pop Blossom's windup, and don't chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter.

Pantheon.build: Early, hold on with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Prioritize armor because Pantheon's main damage is physical and Zilean has relatively low armor. Avoid choices that only greatly increase your health, since Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on maximum health.
Pantheon.combo: From outside Pantheon's engage range, slow him first with Zilean E Time Warp, then stun him with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. If Pantheon leaves the radius before you place the second bomb, the stun won't happen, so start after the slow lands.
Pantheon.escape: Look to engage during a window when both Pantheon W Shield Vault and Pantheon R Grand Starfall are down. If only one is down, wait longer, since he can escape with the other mobility ability. In particular, look for a chance to land Zilean Q Time Bomb before Pantheon R Grand Starfall comes back up.
Pantheon.fight: While Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the front, don't throw bombs straight at him; wait for it to end or find an angle from the side.
Pantheon.laning: Stand behind or beside your allied marksman so Pantheon W Shield Vault can't reach you. Poke with Zilean Q Time Bomb when Pantheon steps forward to last-hit, but save it when you want to pull the lane, since a bomb that attaches to a minion can push the wave.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon's influence falls off in the late game, so protect allies with Zilean E Time Warp and Zilean R Chronoshift.
Pantheon.teamfight: If Pantheon jumps into your backline, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp and stun him with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Use Zilean R Chronoshift just before your main damage dealer is focused. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is facing forward, wait for it to end or throw bombs from the side.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns, so don't give him its range. Keep minions between you and Pantheon when dodging Pantheon Q Comet Spear, and leave the landing area when you see the warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall.

Pyke.build: Early, hold on with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Prioritize armor because Pyke's damage is mainly physical, but also get enough health to stay above his execute threshold. Build Morellonomicon if the healing from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones can turn a fight around.
Pyke.combo: When engaging Pyke, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp, then use Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. If you place the second bomb on Pyke while he's carrying the first, the first detonates immediately and stuns nearby enemies. Pyke can use Pyke E Phantom Undertow to leave the bomb's radius, so dodge that mobility ability before starting the combo.
Pyke.escape: The moment after you dodge Pyke E Phantom Undertow is a chance to engage, but Pyke can use Pyke R Death From Below to escape if it's still available. Look for a chance to slow him with Zilean E Time Warp and land Zilean Q Time Bomb before Pyke R Death From Below comes back up.
Pyke.fight: After sidestepping Pyke E Phantom Undertow, check what escape options Pyke still has from where he ends up before fighting. When engaging, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp, then look for a stun with Zilean Q Time Bomb. In a fight that may last, don't use up Zilean W Rewind completely; leave yourself the option to use it for a second stun or Zilean E Time Warp.
Pyke.laning: Save mana by throwing Zilean Q Time Bomb when Pyke steps forward or is in a position where he can't retreat. After trading, maintain vision along Pyke's retreat path with wards so he can't disappear from sight and heal.
Pyke.phase: In the late game, focus on protecting allies with Zilean E Time Warp and Zilean R Chronoshift rather than poking with bombs.
Pyke.teamfight: Save your main damage dealer by using Zilean R Chronoshift just before they are focused. Pyke R Death From Below can also deal damage around anyone who is wounded, so don't stand next to low-health allies.
Pyke.watch: If Pyke Q Bone Skewer pulls you or Pyke E Phantom Undertow stuns you, you're likely to take a chain of hits, so keep your distance. When Pyke E Phantom Undertow starts, move to the side of its dash path. If the shark shadow from Pyke W Ghostwater Dive appears under your feet, retreat toward an ally or turret, and watch for Pyke R Death From Below when health is low.

Rakan.build: Most of Rakan's damage is magic and Zilean has relatively low magic resistance, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Build Morellonomicon if the healing from Rakan Q Gleaming Quill can turn a fight around.
Rakan.combo: Watch where Rakan W Grand Entrance lands or where Rakan stops. Slow him with Zilean E Time Warp, then use Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. If you place the second bomb on the target carrying the first, the first detonates immediately and stuns nearby enemies.
Rakan.escape: The moment after Rakan W Grand Entrance misses or is down is your chance to engage. If Rakan is separated from allies, he can't escape with Rakan E Battle Dance, so catch him with Zilean E Time Warp's slow and a bomb stun.
Rakan.fight: Look to trade just after Rakan P Fey Feathers' shield is removed. If Rakan W Grand Entrance is down or he's separated from allies and can't use Rakan E Battle Dance, close the gap, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp, and land a bomb stun.
Rakan.laning: Throw Zilean Q Time Bomb when an enemy steps forward and has trouble retreating, and avoid attaching a bomb to a minion and pushing the wave when you're trying to keep the lane pulled back.
Rakan.phase: In the late game, focus on protecting allies with Zilean E Time Warp and Zilean R Chronoshift rather than poking.
Rakan.teamfight: If Rakan jumps into your backline, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp and look for a stun with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Use Zilean R Chronoshift just before Rakan's engage causes your main damage dealer to be focused. Don't stand in a line where Rakan R The Quickness can hit multiple allies.
Rakan.watch: You can see the landing spot for Rakan W Grand Entrance, so sidestep once the dash begins to avoid the knockup. When Rakan R The Quickness is active, it's hard to run away on foot, so don't stand in a line; put terrain between you and Rakan before he reaches you or look for a stun with Zilean Q Time Bomb.

Rell.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Rell’s damage is mostly magic, and Zilean has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If Rell catches you with crowd control, it’s easy to get hit by follow-up attacks, making the tenacity from Mercury’s Treads important too.
Rell.combo: When Rell’s mobility ability is down and she is standing still or slowed, cast Zilean E Time Warp on her, then use Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. If the second bomb lands on Rell while the first is attached, the first detonates immediately and stuns nearby enemies too. Start when Rell can’t get out of the bomb’s radius.
Rell.escape: Don’t engage just because Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down alone is down. Your chance to land Zilean Q Time Bomb and fight comes when Rell E Full Tilt is also down and hasn’t returned. If Rell engages first and you need to retreat, speed yourself up with Zilean E Time Warp and use Zilean W Rewind to get E back sooner.
Rell.fight: Start outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down’s range, and create distance right after Rell uses Crash Down. If Rell E Full Tilt is also down and hasn’t returned, slow Rell with Zilean E Time Warp and trade with a bomb stun. Zilean’s magic damage poke is effective because Rell has relatively low magic resistance.
Rell.laning: From outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down’s range, throw Zilean Q Time Bomb where Rell is about to move forward. Keep your mana and the risk of pushing the wave in mind, and only use it when you can land it.
Rell.phase: From the mid game onward, help your allies move while poking with bombs. In the late game, focus more on protecting your allies.
Rell.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so several of you aren’t pulled in together by Rell R Magnet Storm. If Rell enters your backline, slow her with Zilean E Time Warp and stun her with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Cast Zilean R Chronoshift just before your main damage dealer is focused to save them.
Rell.watch: Watch for Rell E Full Tilt speeding up Rell and an ally to set up Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. When Rell runs toward you, stop trading and move outside Crash Down’s range. Rell Q Shattering Strike travels in a straight line, so dodge sideways. Before a teamfight, spread out from your allies so several of you aren’t pulled in by Rell R Magnet Storm.

Renata.build: Early, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance against the damage from Renata Glasc P Leverage, Renata Glasc Q Handshake, and Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. If the enemy team's crowd control often catches your main damage dealer, build Mikael's Blessing between core items.
Renata.combo: When engaging Renata Glasc, slow her first with Zilean E Time Warp, then use Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. If you place the second bomb on the same target, the first detonates immediately and stuns nearby enemies. Start when Renata Glasc can't get out of the bomb's radius.
Renata.escape: The moment after Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down is your chance to close the gap. Renata Glasc has no mobility of her own, so if you reach her, catch her with Zilean E Time Warp's slow and a stun from Zilean Q Time Bomb.
Renata.fight: If Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down and you can close the gap, catch her by slowing her with Zilean E Time Warp; Renata Glasc has no mobility.
Renata.laning: Stand behind or beside your allied marksman and throw Zilean Q Time Bomb where Renata Glasc will step forward or walk. If the bomb attaches to a minion, it pushes the wave, so save it when you want to pull the lane and use that effect when you want to push and rotate. It costs a lot of mana, so don't throw it carelessly when Renata Glasc can easily retreat.
Renata.phase: In the late game, focus on protecting allies with Zilean E Time Warp and Zilean R Chronoshift rather than dealing damage.
Renata.teamfight: While Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, spread out so allies don't engage bunched together in a line. If an enemy gets into your backline, slow them with Zilean E Time Warp and stun them with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Use Zilean R Chronoshift if your main damage dealer is at risk of dying under focused attacks.
Renata.watch: If Renata Glasc Q Handshake hits you, it can root you and then throw you, stunning nearby allies too, so dodge from behind a minion or frontline. While Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, keep your distance from allies to reduce damage from attacking them after being hit. If you kill an enemy affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout, move away so an ally doesn't die next to them.

Seraphine.build: Early, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance because most of Seraphine's damage is magic and Zilean has relatively low magic resistance.
Seraphine.combo: After Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, slow her with Zilean E Time Warp, then use Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. If you place the second bomb on Seraphine while she's carrying the first, the first detonates immediately and stuns nearby enemies.
Seraphine.escape: Seraphine has no mobility, so the moment after you dodge Seraphine E Beat Drop is a chance to close the gap. Then pin her down with Zilean E Time Warp's slow and follow up with Zilean Q Time Bomb. When the enemy jungler is out of sight, save Zilean E Time Warp for your own escape.
Seraphine.fight: Zilean has no escape ability, so if Seraphine's crowd control catches you, you're likely to be hit by what follows; keep your distance as you fight. If Seraphine E Beat Drop is down and she's separated from the marksman, slow her with Zilean E Time Warp and look for a bomb stun.
Seraphine.laning: Throw Zilean Q Time Bomb where Seraphine will walk when she steps forward to last-hit. If the bomb attaches to a minion, it pushes the wave, so save Q when you want to pull the lane.
Seraphine.phase: In the late game, Zilean E's protection and R's value outweigh his damage, so play to protect your allies.
Seraphine.teamfight: Spread out to the left and right so Seraphine R Encore doesn't follow allies and reach the backline. If an enemy gets into your backline, slow them with Zilean E Time Warp and stun them with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Use Zilean R Chronoshift just before your main damage dealer takes lethal damage.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets, so if you're slowed, move out of the straight line in front of Seraphine. Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it hits an allied champion, so don't stand in a line with allies. Seraphine Q High Note deals more damage at lower health.

Sona.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Sona’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Sona W Aria of Perseverance is enough to turn a fight, build Morellonomicon.
Sona.combo: When Sona steps forward, slow her with Zilean E Time Warp, then use Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Attach the second bomb to the same target to detonate the first immediately and stun nearby enemies too.
Sona.escape: After Sona R Crescendo is down, look for an opening to engage without worrying about getting hit by its stun.
Sona.fight: When Sona steps forward to apply her aura or to last-hit, slow her with Zilean E Time Warp and look for a bomb stun. She can escape with Sona E Song of Celerity, so quickly chain two bombs.
Sona.laning: Stand behind or beside your allied marksman and throw Zilean Q Time Bomb where Sona will walk. Save it when you need to pull the lane back so the bomb doesn’t attach to a minion and push the wave.
Sona.phase: Sona gets stronger as she builds stacks, and she benefits from longer late-game fights, so keep her under pressure early.
Sona.teamfight: Spread out to either side of your allies so several of you aren’t hit by Sona R Crescendo. When Sona comes close to apply her aura to an ally, disrupt her positioning with a Zilean Q Time Bomb stun. If your backline is attacked, use Zilean E Time Warp to slow the diver, and cast Zilean R Chronoshift just before your main damage dealer is focused.
Sona.watch: Sona R Crescendo stuns multiple enemies in a line, so don’t line up with your allies when Sona steps forward. If she enters attack range while Sona P Power Chord is ready, create distance to avoid her empowered attack or slow.

Soraka.build: In the early game, hold out with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Soraka’s damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If her healing can turn a fight, build Morellonomicon and apply Grievous Wounds to multiple enemies with Zilean Q Time Bomb’s area damage.
Soraka.combo: After Soraka E Equinox is down, slow her with Zilean E Time Warp and use Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. If the second bomb lands on Soraka while the first is attached, the first detonates immediately and stuns nearby enemies. Start when Soraka can’t get out of the bomb’s radius.
Soraka.escape: Engage as soon as you confirm Soraka E Equinox was used to poke or clear the wave. Soraka has no mobility ability, so close the distance, slow her with Zilean E Time Warp, and use the stun combo. If Soraka E Equinox’s zone is still there, use your engage ability before stepping into it.
Soraka.fight: Once you’ve closed the distance, slow Soraka with Zilean E Time Warp and follow up with a bomb stun.
Soraka.laning: Throw Zilean Q Time Bomb when Soraka steps forward to last-hit or is in a position where retreating is difficult. Pressure an allied marksman to make Soraka use Soraka W Astral Infusion, which reduces her own health, and dodge Soraka Q Starcall to keep up that pressure. If the bomb attaches to a minion, it will push the lane, so save it when you want to pull the lane toward you and use it when you want to push and join your team.
Soraka.phase: In the mid game, push the lane and then join your allies. In the late game, focus on protecting your allies with Zilean E Time Warp and Zilean R Chronoshift rather than poking.
Soraka.teamfight: Look for a chance to target Soraka herself instead of repeatedly hitting an enemy she’s healing. If enemies dive your backline, slow them with Zilean E Time Warp and stun them with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Cast Zilean R Chronoshift just before your main damage dealer is focused, and concentrate your damage in a short window so Soraka R Wish doesn’t have time to heal them.
Soraka.watch: If Soraka Q Starcall hits you, it slows you while healing Soraka and granting her movement speed, so dodge Q Starcall to keep up the pressure. Watch for silence and roots in Soraka E Equinox’s zone, and use your abilities before stepping into the zone when you engage. Soraka R Wish heals her allies regardless of distance, so keep it in mind during fights in other lanes too.

Swain.build: Swain’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. In the early game, hold out with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots.
Swain.combo: When Swain E Nevermove is down, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp. Start when Swain can’t get out of the bomb’s radius.
Swain.escape: Engage as soon as the returning wave of Swain E Nevermove disappears. Swain has no mobility or escape ability, so slowing him with Zilean E Time Warp and chaining a bomb stun then can create a chance to catch him.
Swain.fight: Right after dodging the returning wave of Swain E Nevermove is your chance. Slow Swain with Zilean E Time Warp, then land a bomb stun. Adjust your distance so you don’t get hit by overlapping Swain Q Death’s Hand at close range.
Swain.laning: Stand behind or beside your allied marksman and poke with Zilean Q Time Bomb as soon as Swain steps forward. If the bomb attaches to a minion, it will push the wave, so save it when you want to pull the lane toward you and use it when you want to push and join your team. Dodge Swain E Nevermove and take early control to limit Swain P Ravenous Flock’s chances to build permanent stacks.
Swain.phase: Swain’s stacks are permanent, so he gets stronger as the game goes on. From the mid game onward, focus more on protecting your allies.
Swain.teamfight: When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, help your allies disengage with Zilean E Time Warp, then fight again after his ultimate ends. If Swain enters your backline, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp and stun him with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Cast Zilean R Chronoshift just before your main damage dealer takes lethal focused damage.
Swain.watch: Swain E Nevermove can root you with its returning wave after it travels outward, so stay out of its path until it fully disappears. When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, he drains and heals from nearby enemies, so get out of range.

Taric.build: In the early game, hold out with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Taric’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Taric Q Starlight’s Touch is enough to turn a fight, build Morellonomicon and apply Grievous Wounds with Zilean Q Time Bomb.
Taric.combo: When Taric E Dazzle is down, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp, then stun him with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Taric has no ability to create distance on his own, so it’s hard for him to leave the bomb’s radius while slowed.
Taric.escape: Right after dodging Taric E Dazzle to the side is your chance to engage. Taric has no ability to create distance on his own, so pin him down with Zilean E Time Warp and look for a bomb stun.
Taric.fight: After dodging Taric E Dazzle, keep your distance and trade with bombs. Slow Taric with Zilean E Time Warp so he can’t get close and auto-attack; this can also delay his ability rotation through Taric P Bravado. Don’t unload damage while Taric R Cosmic Radiance’s damage immunity is active. Attack again the moment it ends.
Taric.laning: Throw Zilean Q Time Bomb when Taric steps forward to last-hit, but save it when your allies are trying to pull the lane toward them so it doesn’t attach to a minion and push the wave. Stand behind or beside your allied marksman to avoid Taric’s melee attacks and Taric E Dazzle.
Taric.phase: In the late game, focus on protecting your allies with Zilean E Time Warp and Zilean R Chronoshift rather than dealing bomb damage.
Taric.teamfight: If a champion linked by Taric W Bastion engages your allies, slow them with Zilean E Time Warp and follow up with a bomb stun. When Taric R Cosmic Radiance’s damage immunity activates, keep the target locked down with Zilean Q Time Bomb stuns until it ends, then attack. Cast Zilean R Chronoshift just before your main damage dealer is focused.
Taric.watch: When you see the tell for Taric E Dazzle, move sideways to dodge it. When Taric R Cosmic Radiance’s damage immunity activates, stop attacking and keep enemies locked down with Zilean Q Time Bomb stuns until it ends.

Thresh.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Thresh deals mostly magic damage, and Zilean has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Also be prepared for situations where, after you are caught by Thresh Q Death Sentence and Thresh E Flay, attacks from your allies follow.
Thresh.combo: If Thresh Q Death Sentence misses and Thresh W Dark Passage is down, slow Thresh with Zilean E Time Warp. Start when Thresh can’t get out of the bomb’s radius.
Thresh.escape: Right after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence is your chance to close the distance. If Thresh W Dark Passage is also down, engage during that window while it’s hard for him to escape and land Zilean Q Time Bomb. If Thresh E Flay is still available, avoid the line between Thresh and his ally so you aren’t pulled in.
Thresh.fight: Start trading right after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence to the side. When Thresh steps forward to collect a soul is also a chance to land Zilean Q Time Bomb. If Thresh W Dark Passage is still available, don’t rush to chase.
Thresh.laning: Throw Zilean Q Time Bomb when Thresh steps forward to collect a soul or is in a position where retreating is difficult. If the bomb attaches to a minion, it will push the wave, so save it when you want to pull the lane toward you.
Thresh.phase: In the late game, Zilean’s damage matters less, so protect your allies with Zilean E Time Warp and Zilean R Chronoshift.
Thresh.teamfight: If Thresh enters your backline, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp and stun him with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. Cast Zilean R Chronoshift just before your main damage dealer is focused. If you’re trapped in Thresh R The Box, choose a wall for your toughest ally to break so you can escape.
Thresh.watch: Thresh Q Death Sentence leads into a stun and dash, so move sideways when you see him raise his hook. Avoid the line between Thresh and his allies so Thresh E Flay doesn’t pull you toward an allied side. Since getting caught makes it easy to take follow-up attacks, stay within range to use Zilean E Time Warp.

Velkoz.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first to prepare for the magic damage from Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission, W Void Rift, and E Tectonic Disruption. You cannot block the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction or R Life Form Disintegration Ray with resistance, so prioritize avoiding consecutive hits from his abilities.
Velkoz.combo: When Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp, then use Zilean Q Time Bomb → W Rewind → Q Time Bomb. If you place the second bomb on Vel'Koz while the first is attached, the first explodes immediately and stuns nearby enemies.
Velkoz.escape: The moment after you dodge or bait out Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is your chance to engage. Vel'Koz has no mobility spell, so slow him with Zilean E Time Warp and follow up with a Zilean Q Time Bomb stun.
Velkoz.fight: After dodging Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp and look for a bomb stun. Vel'Koz has no mobility spell, so you can close the gap and pressure him, but if you get very close, Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption can knock you back. Prepare a way to finish the fight before going in.
Velkoz.laning: As Zilean, stand behind or beside your allied marksman and harass Vel'Koz with Zilean Q Time Bomb where he will step up to last-hit. If a bomb attaches to a minion, it will push the wave, so save Q when you want to pull the lane toward you. Clear vision around the river and tri-brush to open a route to approach from the side and make it harder for Vel'Koz to step up and harass.
Velkoz.phase: In the late game, Zilean contributes less damage, so focus on protecting allies with E Time Warp and R Chronoshift.
Velkoz.teamfight: Cast Zilean R Chronoshift on your main damage dealer just before they come under focused attack. If an enemy dives your backline, stop them with the slow from E Time Warp and a bomb stun.
Velkoz.watch: Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission splits into two bolts even if you dodge the first one, so don't just sidestep it; move toward Vel'Koz or behind where the bolts passed. Watch for the knock-up from Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption and the follow-up hits, and back off to let stacks of Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction wear off when they are applied.

Xerath.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots and build magic resistance to counter Xerath’s main damage.
Xerath.combo: After approaching Xerath, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp and use Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb. When the second bomb attaches, the first detonates immediately and stuns nearby enemies.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility ability, so the moment after Xerath W Eye of Destruction and Xerath E Shocking Orb are down is your chance to engage. Xerath also can’t move during the cast animation of Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, so you can approach his position while dodging the shots.
Xerath.fight: Close the distance right after Xerath W Eye of Destruction and Xerath E Shocking Orb are down. Xerath has no mobility ability, so once you’re close, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp and look for a bomb stun.
Xerath.laning: Throw a bomb where Xerath is about to step forward to last-hit, but conserve mana and account for the wave being pushed if the bomb attaches to a minion. Hold out while dodging Xerath’s heavy damage, then push the lane and call your jungler during the window when mana runs dry.
Xerath.phase: In the late game, focus on protecting your allies with Zilean E Time Warp and Zilean R Chronoshift rather than dealing damage.
Xerath.teamfight: Stay behind your allies to protect your main damage dealer, and cast Zilean R Chronoshift just before an ally stunned by Xerath E Shocking Orb is focused. If Xerath enters Zilean’s bomb range, slow him with Zilean E Time Warp and stun him with Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb.
Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so standing behind them won’t let you dodge it. When Xerath takes his charging stance, change direction and move to the side. Be especially careful to dodge Xerath E Shocking Orb, since its stun makes it easy to take follow-up attacks.

Zyra.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Zyra deals mostly magic damage and Zilean's magic resistance is relatively low, so build magic resistance first.
Zyra.combo: When Zyra E Grasping Roots is down, slow her with Zilean E Time Warp, then use Zilean Q Time Bomb → W Rewind → Q Time Bomb. If you place the second bomb on Zyra while the first is attached, the first explodes immediately and stuns nearby enemies. Start the combo when Zyra cannot get out of the bomb's radius.
Zyra.escape: Zyra has no ability to create distance on her own, so the opening to engage is right after you dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots sideways. Slow her then with Zilean E Time Warp and catch her with Zilean Q Time Bomb.
Zyra.fight: After dodging Zyra E Grasping Roots, close the gap where there are no plants and start trading. Zyra has no way to escape on her own, so slow her with Zilean E Time Warp and look for a bomb stun. Zilean has no ability to escape on his own, so don't force an engage while Zyra's root is still available.
Zyra.laning: As Zilean, stand behind or beside your allied marksman and throw Zilean Q Time Bomb when Zyra steps forward or goes for a last-hit. If Zilean Q Time Bomb attaches to a minion, it will push the wave, so save it when you want to pull the lane toward you. Check bushes where Zyra has lingered with a Control Ward or an ability first, since she may have vision or be setting up an ambush.
Zyra.phase: In the late game, focus more on protecting allies with E Time Warp and R Chronoshift than on dealing damage as Zilean.
Zyra.teamfight: Don't take a fight where Zyra has built up seeds and plants; move to different terrain. If Zyra approaches your backline, slow her with Zilean E Time Warp and stun her with Q Time Bomb → W Rewind → Q Time Bomb. Cast Zilean R Chronoshift on your main damage dealer just before they come under focused attack.
Zyra.watch: If you are rooted by Zyra E Grasping Roots, you are likely to take follow-up plant damage, so dodge sideways at the edge of its range. When you see the summon indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns, use Zilean E Time Warp on yourself to speed up and leave the area. If there are many plants nearby, back off briefly and fight after they disappear.
